biggest_catch: 'Up to $20 per hour' is a ceiling, not a floor - and some studies pay by entering you in a prize drawing instead of guaranteed pay, so check the study announcement before signing up.
catches: Rate is 'up to $20 per hour' - no guaranteed floor; actual pay varies by study
Some studies pay via prize drawings instead of guaranteed compensation - not every study pays cash
Payment form/amount is only disclosed per-study in the Sona announcement
Payments processed within 7 business days, not instantly
In-person studies require travel to NYU Stern (many studies are online though)

c1.evidence: stern.nyu.edu participant pages fetched from search index (crawled 3 and 14 days before verification); pay terms quoted verbatim

c2.evidence: Official page states concrete rate: 'making up to $20 per hour participating in surveys'; FAQ: 'studies pay up to $20 per hour'

c3.evidence: Steps from official page: register a participant account, receive study announcement emails, sign up, complete study

c4.evidence: Free to register; no fee; short questionnaires/surveys, no physical exertion or medical procedures

eligibility: Anyone 18+ can sign up; no NYU affiliation required (non-NYU users create a User ID ending in @nyu.edu)
notes: Standing participant pool of NYU Stern's Center for Behavioral Research. Distinct from NYU's Center for Experimental Social Science (CESS, verified separately as R3048). Because the official rate is 'up to $20/hr' with no floor and some studies pay via drawings, payout_min is 0.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (up to $20/hr ceiling, no floor; drawing-only studies possible); time: stated 15-30 min typical studies plus registration estimate
payout_quote: Are you interested in making up to $20 per hour participating in surveys?
payout_value_note: Official stated ceiling of $20/hr; no floor guaranteed; per-study pay disclosed in each Sona study announcement.

s1.note: Provider's own stated hourly ceiling; no conversion

s2.note: Framed as a ceiling with variable per-study pay; drawing-only studies disclosed

s3.note: Catches cover no floor, drawing-only studies, per-study disclosure

s5.note: Timing: processed within 7 business days after study completion

s6.note: Deduped: no NYU route in catalog or evidence files; distinct from NYU CESS (R3048)

s7.note: 'up to' is the operative hedge in the payout quote

steps: Register for a participant account (non-NYU users create a User ID ending in @nyu.edu and email behavior.lab@stern.nyu.edu)
Receive Study Announcement emails for new research opportunities
Check each study announcement for its duration and payment form/amount
Sign up for a study and complete it (mostly online; some in-person at NYU)
Receive payment within 7 business days (cash, gift card, PayPal, or Campus Cash)
timing: Payments processed within 7 business days after study completion.
